title: 第1609章 佛皇舍身第1608章 超凡当求取于帷幕之内
slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: 佛皇缓缓走到净浊二世的边界，也就是帷幕之上。
他是帷幕的缔造者之一，自然不受认知壁垒的影响。
他看着因认知不足于姜尤的三位浊王在元始神山的浊世中分开行走，他看到那头无头的初王身躯终于因为失去了目标而停下了脚步。
浊世生灵想要突破到帷幕之外，除非侵入帷幕之外的生灵的身躯，因为帷幕本身，除了有浊王尸骸之外，还有圣皇的剑光。
任何幸运的浊世生灵，若是胆敢走出帷幕，必遭受剑光的毁灭！
即便浊王也是如此！
剩下的三位浊王或许在未来的某个时间，会清醒过来，通过各种手段，引诱正常世界的众生误入。
但帷幕的确分割了内外，护住了众生，
不过，这样还不够。
“我要为那些勇于踏入帷幕之内，探索世间真相，走上超凡之路的人们，给予洗净一切尘埃和污染的希望。
他缓缓走近帷幕之内，进入浊世的范围内。
因着他的进入。
那三位浊世之王，以及那尊无头的初王身躯，纷纷感受到了强烈的净土气息，纷纷朝他看来。
他们重新找到了目标。
但佛皇并不搭理他们，而是抬头看上即便在帷幕之内，也能够看到的白金之月。
它深藏暗红之色，却皎皎洁白，不像是存在于这样的污秽世界的事物。
金蟾子微笑着说道。
“伟大的圣皇陛下啊。”
“请允许我为这座无尽净浊的帷幕，加上一点别的东西。”
天穹之上。
白金的月亮微微颤动。
一道叹息的声音在他的心中想起。
“你其实不必如此，金蟾子。”
“不，陛下，我必须如此。”
“众生虽生，但没有了前路，就是没有了希望。”
“帷幕总有被打破的一天，当认知的壁垒破碎，众生如何自救？“
“而且，浊世大势滔滔，我们的帷幕只是暂时之法，我们需要源源不断的超脱者出现，对抗它！”
“故而。”
“我以我的一切，发大宏愿！”
“我愿化身莲花，于无尽帷幕之内，燃起无形的净世之火，高悬帷幕之内，为无数超凡者，截取一线生机。”
“因求取超凡或力量，而被浊世污染者，若意志足够坚定，思想足够认真，当可以涅盘而重生，获的净土之气。”
“取浊世之能量，化为生灵之实力，而后点燃净世之火，重获新生！”
在未来。
虽然凡人想要觉醒超凡力量，便需要接触帷幕，探索帷幕之内，来获得超凡力量。
但只要他们的意志坚定，心神强大，不被浊世的天意干扰，不被帷幕内的浊世生灵杀死，也不被自身的力量所引入歧途堕落。
当他们的力量抵达了某一种层次，净世之火便会降临，将他们身上的一切污秽燃烧殆尽，重新成为心灵澄净的状态。
如此往复，便终有登临绝巅的机会！
佛皇金蟾子此时发下宏愿，无尽帷幕瞬间震动！
浊世天意顿时感受到了强烈的威胁，连白金之月内的黑红之气也开始膨胀。
现在。
佛皇即将要做的事情，对帷幕之内的浊世是极为不利的。
在白金之月内。
那道黑红色的身影甚至有些惊讶和嘲讽的看着白金光辉身影，大笑道。
“你们先分净浊，建立帷幕，又要在帷幕之内，设立净化之能。”
“尤利尔，你难道是想要借此帷幕，将整个超脱之上，和我净浊共分吗？”
content_en:
The Buddha Emperor slowly walked to the boundary of Jingzhuo II, which was above the curtain.
He is one of the founders of the Veil, so he is naturally not affected by cognitive barriers.
He watched the three Zhuo Kings, who were not as knowledgeable as Jiang You, walking separately in the troubled world of the Yuanshi Mountain. He saw that the headless body of the First King finally stopped because it lost its target.
If the creatures of the troubled world want to break through the curtain, they must invade the bodies of the creatures outside the curtain, because the curtain itself contains not only the corpse of King Zhuo, but also the sword light of the Holy Emperor.
Any lucky creature in troubled times who dares to step out of the curtain will be destroyed by the light of the sword!
Even King Zhuo is like this!
The remaining three Zhuo Kings may wake up at some time in the future and use various means to lure sentient beings from the normal world into entering.
But the curtain does separate the inside and outside and protects all living beings.
However, this is not enough.
“I want to give those who have the courage to step inside the veil, explore the truth of the world, and embark on the extraordinary path, the hope of washing away all dust and pollution.
He slowly approached the curtain and entered the realm of troubled times.
Because of His entry.
The three kings of the troubled world, as well as the headless body of the First King, felt the strong pure land aura and looked at him one after another.
They found their purpose again.
But the Buddha Emperor paid no attention to them, but looked up at the platinum moon that could be seen even within the curtain.
It has a deep dark red color, but is bright and white, not like something that exists in such a filthy world.
Jinchanzi said with a smile.
"His Majesty the Great Holy Emperor. "
"Please allow me to add something else to this endless pure curtain. "
Above the sky.
The platinum moon trembled slightly.
A sighing sound came to mind in his mind.
"You don't have to be like this, Jinchanzi. "
"No, Your Majesty, I must. "
“Although all living beings are alive, if there is no way forward, there is no hope. "
“The curtain will be broken one day. When the barriers to cognition are broken, how can all sentient beings save themselves? "
"Furthermore, the troubled times are raging, and our curtain is only a temporary method. We need a steady stream of transcendent people to appear to fight against it! "
"Therefore. "
“I have great ambitions with everything I have! "
"I wish to transform into a lotus flower, ignite the invisible purifying fire within the endless curtain, hang high within the curtain, and intercept a glimmer of life for countless extraordinary beings. "
"Those who are polluted by the troubled world because of seeking transcendence or power, if their will is firm enough and their thoughts are serious enough, they can be reborn in Nirvana and obtain the breath of the pure land. "
"Take the energy of the troubled world, turn it into the strength of living beings, then ignite the fire of the purifying world, and regain a new life! "
in the future.
Although mortals want to awaken extraordinary power, they need to contact the curtain and explore within it to obtain extraordinary power.
But as long as their will is firm and their minds are strong, they will not be disturbed by the will of the troubled world, will not be killed by the creatures in the troubled world within the veil, and will not be led astray and corrupted by their own power.
When their power reaches a certain level, the purifying fire will come, burning away all the filth in them, and they will regain a state of spiritual purity.
If you keep going like this, you will finally have the chance to reach the top!
The Buddha Emperor Jinchanzi made a great wish at this time, and the endless curtain shook instantly!
The Heavenly Will of the Troubled World suddenly felt a strong threat, and even the black and red energy in the Platinum Moon began to expand.
Now.
What the Buddha Emperor is about to do is extremely detrimental to the troubled times within the curtain.
Within the Platinum Moon.
The black-red figure even looked at the white-gold figure with some surprise and ridicule, and laughed.
“You must first separate the pure from the turbid and build the curtain, and then set up the power of purification within the curtain. "
"Uriel, do you want to use this curtain to separate the entire transcendence from my pure and turbid nature? "
title_en: Chapter 1609 The Buddha Emperor sacrificed his life Chapter 1608 The extraordinary should be obtained within the curtain
